verdict.rationale: Square's docs confirm hardware-based payment acceptance (Terminal API, Take Payments on Hardware, Tap to Pay on iPhone) and general ease-of-use marketing, but no concrete pairing/registration walkthrough or independent hands-on account of reader setup speed is provided; some community commentary raises trust/security skepticism about phone-based readers without disputing actual functionality. Missing for 10: explicit reader-pairing/registration steps, independent hands-on timing evidence, and confirmation that setup truly takes 'minutes'.
